direct_experimental_variant_effects.gap: Genomic placement is incomplete. Ensembl expands protein-level variants into candidate codon alleles (990 of 1,402 sets); MaveDB's own mapper assigns genomic HGVS to only about 317k of 3.07M annotated variants. 197 of our sets are absent from the CC0 dump (non-CC0 or newer). Superseded versions (51 human-target sets) exist only as a labelled extension. Scores are not comparable across sets and calibrations exist for few sets.
direct_experimental_variant_effects.next: Build one variant-level table keyed by VRS digest/ClinGen allele ID that links assay variant, mapped alleles and annotations; treat superseded versions explicitly; do not pool raw scores across sets.

protein_structure_function.gap: UniProt reviewed human table is acquired and joins to 98% of MaveDB proteins; AlphaFold models, InterPro matches and variant-level stability predictors (Ensembl ProtVar 1.3 GB, mutfunc 2.0 GB) are not fetched.
protein_structure_function.next: Fetch AlphaFold models and InterPro matches per MaveDB target protein through their APIs; evaluate ProtVar/mutfunc for variant-level structural effects.

regulation_expression_splicing.gap: Only GTEx median expression and SCREEN cCRE intervals are acquired. No eQTL/sQTL tables, no splicing predictions (SpliceAI 27 GB, SpliceVault 843 MB) and no sequence-to-function predictions (Enformer 2.8 GB). cCREs are predicted elements, not variant effects.
regulation_expression_splicing.next: Pull Open Targets credible_set/colocalisation/enhancer_to_gene subsets; evaluate SpliceVault; use MPRA score sets already in MaveDB for regulatory variants.

perturbation_evidence.gap: BioGRID ORCS human screens are acquired and validated (licence unconfirmed). DepMap is behind a human-verification wall and was not fetched. IMPC (mouse) is not fetched. No variant-level perturbation (base-editing) source is catalogued.
perturbation_evidence.next: User downloads DepMap Public from its downloads page (or use Open Targets target_essentiality); fetch Open Targets evidence_crispr/evidence_impc; assess base-editor screens.

natural_knockouts_dosage.gap: gnomAD v4.1.2 constraint and ClinGen HI/TS gene and region sets are acquired. Not covered: gnomAD LoF curation, homozygous LoF counts, Open Targets gene-burden evidence.
natural_knockouts_dosage.next: Fetch gnomAD lof_curation and Open Targets evidence_gene_burden.

association_finemapping_coloc.gap: Only the flat GWAS Catalog associations table is acquired. Fine-mapping, colocalisation and locus-to-gene evidence (Open Targets) and eQTL Catalogue credible sets are catalogued but not fetched. No LD reference panel is acquired (1000 Genomes genotypes not fetched).
association_finemapping_coloc.next: Pull selected Open Targets Parquet datasets (study, credible_set, colocalisation, l2g_prediction) for the MaveDB gene set; decide the LD source.

functional_haplotypes_pgx.gap: ClinPGx and CPIC tables are acquired. PharmVar licence and bulk route are unverified, so haplotype definitions at sequence level are missing.
functional_haplotypes_pgx.next: Read PharmVar terms manually; use its API if permitted.

structural_variation_cnv.gap: gnomAD exome CNV and ClinGen recurrent CNV/dosage regions are acquired. Not fetched: gnomAD SV (1.74 GB), DGV (364 MB), 1000 Genomes/HGSVC SV callsets. dbVar currency is unknown and DECIPHER denied access.
structural_variation_cnv.next: Fetch gnomAD SV and DGV GRCh38; inspect dbVar contents and dates.

repeat_expansions_str.gap: STRchive disease loci (82, hg38) are acquired. Population allele-size distributions (gnomAD TR) and genome-wide reference catalogues (PlatinumTRs, 7.8M loci) are not.
repeat_expansions_str.next: Fetch gnomAD tandem-repeat and PlatinumTRs data when STR calling is in scope.

pathways_interactions_epistasis.gap: Reactome mappings are acquired. No protein/genetic interaction database is acquired (BioGRID interactions, IntAct, STRING not assessed) and nothing in the library quantifies epistasis or compensation.
pathways_interactions_epistasis.next: Assess interaction resources and digenic/oligogenic disease databases; Open Targets interaction dataset is a candidate.

clinical_interpretation.gap: ClinVar (2026-10-19) and ClinGen gene-disease validity are acquired and join to MaveDB variants (10.1% of mapped SNV alleles have an exact ClinVar record). OMIM is licensed, HPO/Monarch are not assessed, DECIPHER is access-controlled.
clinical_interpretation.next: Assess HPO/Monarch/MONDO; keep ClinVar release dates in every result.

population_frequency.gap: No frequency table is acquired directly. gnomAD v4.1 VCFs are hundreds of GiB per chromosome and are deliberately deferred; the dump annotations carry gnomAD allele frequency for only 5,942 mapped variants. 1000 Genomes contributes a 3,202-sample population table only.
population_frequency.next: Use regional tabix/API access or Ensembl/dbNSFP frequency fields for the variants of interest; avoid mirroring gnomAD.

annotation_integration.gap: The best integrators are not yet usable: dbNSFP needs institutional registration, Ensembl VEP caches/plugin data are not fetched (MaveDB plugin file is), Open Targets Parquet is not fetched. AlphaMissense gene-level scores are acquired; the 643 MB variant file is tier B.
annotation_integration.next: Ask the user to register for dbNSFP; fetch the AlphaMissense variant file and the VEP GRCh38 cache when annotation begins.

reference_annotation.gap: MANE v1.5 summary and GTF are acquired and bridge Ensembl, RefSeq, HGNC and NCBI IDs for all joins. GENCODE v50 and the genome FASTA are not fetched.
reference_annotation.next: Fetch GENCODE/FASTA when sequence extraction is needed.

resource_catalogues.gap: OpenEBench tool counts are derived (bio.tools API is bot-protected). FAIRsharing records are not harvested (API needs an account).
resource_catalogues.next: Optional: user supplies a FAIRsharing token.

background_documentation.gap: Background pages only; no variant-level evidence.

needs.dbnsfp: User registers with an institutional email at dbnsfp.org and requests download links (about 50 GB); licence CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 forbids redistributing derivatives.
needs.depmap: User downloads DepMap Public files manually from the DepMap downloads page (portal asks automated clients not to scrape), or use Open Targets target_essentiality.
needs.decipher: User applies for DECIPHER data access.
needs.pharmvar: Read the PharmVar terms of use manually, then use its API or downloads.
needs.fairsharing: User creates a FAIRsharing account/token if programmatic harvesting is wanted.
needs.eqtl_catalogue: Use FTP (API retired); metadata tables are hosted in a GitHub repository outside this session's scope.
needs.dbvar: Inspect FTP contents and dates before use.
needs.biotools: bio.tools API is behind a bot challenge; OpenEBench is used instead.
